chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman who said: Abu Baseer narrated to me, saying: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:

A man was miles away from Medina, and he saw in his dream that it was said to him, 'Go and pray over Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), for the angels are washing him in Al-Baqi'. So the man came and found that Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) had passed away.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja'far, referring to Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon him)
key_terms.أَمْيَالٍ: plural of mile, indicating a distance of several miles
key_terms.تُغَسِّلُهُ: they wash him (ritual washing of the dead)

ai.seo_question: What happened when a man traveled to Medina after seeing a dream about the washing of Abu Ja'far in Al-Baqi?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Shia belief in the spiritual presence of the Imams even after their physical death, illustrating how the angels' washing of Abu Ja'far al-Manzur in Al-Baqi serves as a sign for the faithful. It underscores the concept of 'ghayb' (unseen knowledge) and the continued spiritual connection between the Imam and his followers, reinforcing the legitimacy of the Ahl al-Bayt's status in the afterlife.
